sources.title: Free AI Leak Checker — Detect PII in LLM Prompts | AI Security Gateway
sources.snippet: When you send a prompt to an AI model, that data travels to the provider's servers. If your prompt contains PII (names, emails, SSNs), secrets (API keys, passwords), or confidential business data, that information is now outside your control. Some providers may use it for training. Regulations like GDPR, HIPAA, and SOC2 require you to prevent this.

sources.title: How indirect prompt injection attacks on AI work - ZDNET
